known_start: zero joint state on the same VirtualPmacController
reset: When the post-cycle pose is not the zero joint state, a new MOVE_JOINT back to zero is validated and executed on that same controller. This restore is not one of the 500 cycles. controller.reset() is only the P-006 ERROR to CONNECTED fault reset and preserves joints.
settling_rule: P-009 monitor rule. max abs joint error <= 1e-9 rad for 3 consecutive samples after execution start. Not assigned from the controller COMPLETED flag.
timeout_policy: A cycle times out when the monitor is still TRACKING at max_execution_steps. The step limit is the P-009 monitor value and is not retuned.
timing_semantics: Duration and settling use the controller project clock recorded by the P-009 monitor. They are not P-007 ROS transport latency and not wall-clock real-time.
resource_semantics: current process RSS is observed. Growth is not by itself a leak. Unbounded monotonic growth, process failure, or OOM fails the run.
